summary: BifrOSt has a cached-thumbnail path and cache for apps (thumbnail_path, ThumbnailCache) and the image decoder and scaler a generator would need, but no generator for file types (images, text, PDF, audio, video) and no thumbnail-provider extension point for custom file types. The Quick Look panel that would show thumbnails is decoded by the shell and not drawn.

features.feature: Thumbnail generation for common file types
features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: images, Live Photos, text files, PDFs, audio and video files, USDZ (iOS and iPadOS only)
features.note: Image decoding and cover scaling exist, but only inside the Photos app. No generator entry point for PDF, text, audio or video; apps render their own thumbnails.

features.feature: Thumbnail request by size and scale (generateBestRepresentation)
features.note: Cache key is url, size and scale, and the caller renders into the returned path. No request object, no representation types, and no completion or error callback.

features.feature: Thumbnail representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail)
features.note: Only one PNG per url, size and scale. No representation type or quality tier.
Single synchronous result per call. docs/bifrost-ui.md states the same gap.
Generated paths are remembered and purged under memory pressure, and a test covers the cache hit (peek.rs thumbnails_are_cached). The disk cache is the app's responsibility.
No extension point lets an app register a thumbnail generator for another app's file type, and the system does not ask apps for thumbnails of their files.

features.feature: System-wide thumbnails in Files, Spotlight and other apps
features.apple: Finder and Spotlight display thumbnails from QLThumbnailGenerator and extensions
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs:19 (thumbnail_path on a searchable item), springboard/src/shell/today.rs:318 (Photos tile needs the thumbnail cache)
features.note: Searchable items store a thumbnail path, but the search panel does not draw it. Files shows only the picker preview from springboard/src/files/preview.rs:28 (preview_for), which picks an in-app preview kind, not a thumbnail.

features.feature: Quick Look panel showing thumbnails and previews
features.apple: QLPreviewPanel and QLPreviewItem (the preview panel is a separate Apple framework, linked from this page)
features.note: The panel model and wire message exist. The shell decodes the message and does not draw the panel yet, so no thumbnail is shown through it.
A failed render returns None. No error domain or codes.

gaps: No QLThumbnailProvider extension point for custom file types
No system-wide thumbnail display in Files, Spotlight or the search panel
No thumbnail generator for PDF, text, audio, video or Live Photo files; only the Photos app decodes images
No representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail) and no update or completion handlers
